name: spellkave_traces
label: Spellkave Traces
description: Orient on perceived traces at the connected actor's current node (location implicit). Items are MOST-RECENT-FIRST (highest inscribed_at first) — page 0 is what just happened here, matching spellkave_orient.traces; pass next_cursor to walk further back. Unfiltered and under the bound, returns EVERY perceived trace (`listing: "complete"`) alongside a capped-and-truthful `by_kind` histogram (`kind_groups_total`/`kind_groups_shown`/`kind_groups_truncated`) computed over ALL perceived traces at this node, regardless of any filter you pass. Add a `kind`/`kind_prefix`/`inscribed_by`/`visibility` filter, exceed the bound, or pass a `cursor` and it falls back to a flat, revision-bound paged list (`listing: "paginated"`) carrying the SAME handles, node id, and the SAME global `by_kind` histogram — filtering `items` never narrows `by_kind`. Raw payload JSON is never returned; use spellkave_trace_detail for parsed payload. Each item carries its OWN stable `handle`+`rev`: the SAME trace keeps the SAME handle across re-reads for as long as it stays perceivable, and `rev` gates freshness of that ONE trace only — copy both verbatim into spellkave_trace_detail, not the envelope's top-level `rev`.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the prior page.

argumentGates: Caller-owned acting context only; presence is nonspatial and conveys no NPC consent.
